snippet.title: How to NOT Get Your Ship Blown Up - SCOS Dev Blog #1
snippet.description:
Our lead developer Dustin Weitkunat breaks down the critical combat systems that separate rookie captains from seasoned officers in Starship Command: Orion Spur. Learn why managing your ship's heat buildup is just as important as your shield strength, and discover how the power distribution system creates meaningful tactical decisions in every engagement. Dustin walks through a real combat scenario, showing how pushing your neutron beams too hard can cripple your ship faster than enemy fire, and demonstrates the delicate balance between offensive firepower and defensive positioning that defines authentic capital ship warfare. Whether you're planning to command from the bridge or take direct control in the pilot's seat, understanding these interconnected systems could mean the difference between victory and becoming space debris. Master these fundamentals and you'll be ready to take on anything the enemy throws at your crew!
